name: Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS)
description: Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) integration for Drupal.
project_description: Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) integration for Drupal. The module exposes a single unauthenticated-by-design HTTP endpoint at /_amazon-sns/notify that receives inbound SNS messages, cryptographically validates each message's AWS signature with the AWS SDK MessageValidator, and re-dispatches it as a Symfony event (amazon_sns_notification, amazon_sns_subscription_confirmation, or amazon_sns_unsubscribe_confirmation). Other modules or custom code subscribe to those events to react to push notifications instead of polling. A bundled subscriber auto-confirms new subscriptions by GETting the signed SubscribeURL, and an optional logger records message IDs and topic ARNs. Requires the AWS SDK for PHP via Composer.
